geometryMethod: Ordinary linear blend skin evaluated from real mesh vertices, weights and pose/inverse-bind matrices; ray-parity solid-inside classification and nearest triangle distance on consistently outward closed skinned body/armor/weapon solids. UV seams are welded only for closed-solid classification. Open decorative sheets/trim cannot define an inside volume and are listed separately. Outer cloth surface vertices are measured; solidified shell thickness is 4 mm.
sampling: Every 1 frame(s) at 100 fps plus exact contact frames on the independently reopened baked file

Walk.estimation: twice average single-ankle fore/aft travel per full left-right gait cycle

Run.estimation: twice average single-ankle fore/aft travel per full left-right gait cycle

runtimeHook: createWarlordSecondary(THREE, actorRoot, {groundHeight}); each frame prepare() before mixer, then update(dt,{action,actionTime,grounded}) after mixer and actor world transform, before weapon FX sampling. reset() on trial reset. World-space 2-bone feet remain planted while root step/turn changes; body/leg/weapon capsule checks protect mixed poses.

verificationProvenance.note: The full baseline had one submillimeter contact at Attack3 frame17. Only that cloth frame was corrected; all 12 other action channels and interpolation bytes are identical to the baseline. The modified Attack3 was independently reopened and measured at all 101 frames. Combined coverage is the entire 13-action, 1300-frame animation set.
